items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $636 Million as October Turns Red Again
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $635.6 million on Thursday, their biggest outflow of the month, pushing October flows back to a loss of about $176 million as Ethereum and Solana funds also bled.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs swing back to net outflows as $636 million in withdrawals erase previous day’s inflows
items.summary: BlackRock's IBIT led Thursday's net outflows with $254.1 million, while four other funds also witnessed withdrawals.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs bleed $635M as October slides back into the red
items.summary: Thursday’s withdrawals ended a three-day inflow streak and left US spot Bitcoin ETFs with $175 million in net outflows for October.
